families.label: Employment-to-population ratio, ages 15+, ILO modelled
families.denominator: Population aged 15 years and over, not total population
families.relationship: Commissioned: the stock of employment is related to availability of paid work; it does not identify which condition binds access.
families.limitation: A lower employment stock share does not count people who lost income routes: entry, exit, population change and job retention offset; hours, earnings and dependants are unmeasured.

families.label: Unemployment rate, ages 15+, ILO modelled
families.denominator: Labour force aged 15 years and over, employed plus unemployed
families.relationship: Commissioned: unsuccessful access to employment relates to availability of paid work; unemployment alone cannot establish its binding cause.
families.limitation: The unemployed are not the total population and may never have held a job. Unemployment excludes many people outside the labour force and does not measure income lost, informal-work quality or dependants.

families.label: Poverty headcount at $3 per day, 2021 PPP, publisher lineup
families.denominator: Persons in the national reporting population; household income or consumption is assigned per person
families.relationship: Commissioned: resources below a fixed purchasing-power threshold relate to affordability; poverty does not identify why access to income is constrained.
families.limitation: A poverty-stock change is not a count of newly disrupted income routes. Welfare includes consumption or income and can reflect transfers and prices. Publisher lineup, nowcast and CMD values are not surveys or independent observations. No affected-household mapping is supplied.
